claim: An American basketball coach  served as a coach at Montana Tech. He also led the Houston Cougars men's basketball team during the season when the team finished in tenth and lost to Tulsa. Tony Crocker played college basketball at CUSA under this coach.

Page: 2014–15 Houston Cougars men's basketball team. Sentence: They advanced to the quarterfinals of the 2015 American Conference Tournament, where they lost to Tulsa.
